digest.component_or_area: CI gate, module-size contract, reconciler documentation
propositions: Module-size allowlist and ceilings files are now orphaned and unused after Phase 2a migrated to absolute cap enforcement.
Documentation in docs/architecture.md and AGENTS.md still references the retired allowlist escape hatch and must be updated to reflect the absolute 800 LOC cap and admin-locked limit model.
Three stale comments in the reconciler modules incorrectly claim route_inbound_probe lives in or is kept in reconcile.py when it actually lives in reconcile_helpers.py and is re-exported.
The module-size contract test must be enhanced to assert the allowlist and ceilings files no longer exist as a verification that cleanup is complete.
